items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: When I graduated, I went right straight to be with the Cruzes. His name was Jim Cruz, Big Jim Cruz.

ctx.x: Well in, during the year 1933, there used to be a Mexican band out of Santa An a. And the family that, that had the band in the, in, in the, in the dance business, the dance-hall business -- they had the band, and they asked me, "You're a graduate, Russell; why don't you come and live with us and rehearse our band?" So I did. When I graduated, I went right straight to be with the Cruzes. His name was Jim Cruz, Big Jim Cruz. And a, was a nice family, and I rehearsed their bands, and we played dances. And then I…
Who was the leader of that band, of Max Melody Makers? Do you recall?
